text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAGH—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Showing sheer dominance! Sirius Symboli—!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!! Sirius-senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Sirius Symboli runs a hell of a race, doesn't she!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
We've definitely got to keep an eye on her next race.
...Honestly, I'd love to cover her training sessions too.

text_block_list.name: Big Corporation Executive
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time seeing her run in person, but...
Yes, I might consider investing.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Haha!
This is irresistible...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Nn... Huh? C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sirius.
Race me at the next Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Your races look so exceptionally delicious, I just had to have a taste.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? And here I was wondering who the rare guest was.
The Japan Cup, huh...
Speaking of the Japan Cup, it's a grand stage where top contenders from home and abroad gather. Considering our current goals, it's not a bad choice at all. And—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I'm running too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My blood is boiling! I really want to have
a proper match with you once.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...You all make it sound so simple,
but haven't you retired from the front lines?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm famous for defying common sense anyway.
I don't care.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. She's definitely missing a screw.
Hard to believe she's a friend of that "Emperor" of ours."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Fine, let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To head overseas, you need solid "results" one way or another.
I was just looking for a sizeable wall to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...!
Haha, treating me like a stepping stone? Now that's interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show 'em what's what.
Just what Japan's "Ace" is made of...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, well, that's something to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —C.B.! I'm heading home first!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Things are getting interesting.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for readily accepting.
I'll see you at the Japan Cup, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"—I have no intention
of letting you build up any 'results.'"
And so, in an unexpected turn of events, a rematch with two formidable rivals was set for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing them will put me in prime position, no doubt.
I'll blow past 'em and seize it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We're going back to workshop this.
Get fired up, Trainer.

To soar to even greater heights—
I refuse to let the Japan Cup slip away!
